name: smwmusic-the-legend-of-zelda-a-link-to-the-past-drop-the-beat-ganon-dark-world-remix
title: The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past - Drop the Beat, Ganon! ~ Dark World (Remix)
description:
Did an arrangement of Dark World from The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past. Another unfinished remix from 2023 that I pulled out because I should've done this back in 2023.

Important:
ㅤ♠ "Bonus End," Yoshi SFX, & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. C Minor w/ Detune (Remix Pitch)ㅤ[Listening-Only]
ㅤ1. C Minor (Original Pitch)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ2. C# Minor (Custom Pitch 1)
ㅤ3. D Minor (Custom Pitch 2)
ㅤ4. A# Minor (Custom Pitch 3)

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. Enables the voice clip, but sacrifices SMW-Compatibility (Voice Enabled)ㅤ[Listening-Only]
ㅤ2. Disables the voice clip & Decreases the Echo (LOWER Echo)ㅤ[turned on by default]
